IEEE CASS Student Design Competition 2027

Prepare an electronics / circuits design project, local demonstration and technical reports.

FIRST PRIZE
$3,000
Reward details
Cash prize pool reported in the supplied research.
Registration deadline
11 Jan 2027 (exact cutoff time not announced)
Format & location
Hybrid · Regional stages + Bordeaux, France
Who can apply
Global undergraduate teams, including India through Region 10; mentor and membership conditions apply.
Team size
3–10 participants

Entry notes

  • At least three team members require IEEE/CASS membership for 2026 and 2027.
  • Final in June 2027. Conference registration and limited travel grants cover up to three members; accommodation is not promised.
